english.rationale: EF EPI 2025 puts Kazakhstan at 417 (rank 107, Very low), but Almaty's city score is 457, in the Low band. Russian is the everyday lingua franca. English works in hotels, specialty cafés and among younger professionals, but rentals, taxis and bazaars usually need Russian or a translation app.

vibe: Leafy grid city under the Tian Shan: ski lifts, alpine lakes and a café scene within an hour of each other
narrative: Tree-lined avenues, Soviet-modernist landmarks and the Green Bazaar sit at the foot of the Trans-Ili Alatau, with Shymbulak's ski lifts and Big Almaty Lake all within about an hour (the Medeu rink is closed for reconstruction until about late 2027). Late spring and September are the best months. Winter brings skiing, but also a coal-heating smog that settles in the valley.

season.rationale: Editorial estimate. June–August is the main visitor season, when mountain trails and lakes are open. Late May–June and September are the recommended windows. The Shymbulak ski season (roughly Dec–Mar, best mid-Jan to Feb) gives a second, mostly regional bump. March and November are the off-months: slush, short days and heating smog.

safety.propertyNote: Pickpocketing on transport and in bazaars; night-time robberies near bars
safety.womensSafetyNote: Generally safe by day; caution at night and in nightlife

rationale.property: Editorial estimate. The FCDO calls pickpocketing very common in markets and on public transport, with foreigners frequently targeted, and reports night-time robberies near bars and clubs in Almaty's expat areas. That puts it below Tbilisi and Yerevan (80) and near Sarajevo (72).
rationale.tourist: The risks (unofficial taxis, nightlife robberies, card skimming) can be avoided with standard precautions and aren't markedly worse for visitors than for locals, so the modifier stays at 1.0.
rationale.womens: No city-specific evidence that departs from the national Gallup baseline. The FCDO's drink-spiking warning applies to nightclubs nationwide, so the delta is 0.

consulted.title: UK FCDO: Kazakhstan safety and security
consulted.quote: Pickpocketing is very common in crowded places such as markets and on public transport.
consulted.note: Also flags night robberies near nightclubs in Almaty, unofficial taxis, card fraud and high earthquake risk

consulted.title: U.S. State Dept travel advisories feed (cadataapi.state.gov)
consulted.quote: Kazakhstan is generally a safe destination for travelers.
consulted.note: Official State Dept JSON feed; travel.state.gov itself served a Cloudflare bot challenge

climateAir.notes: Almaty has a well-documented winter smog season: coal heating combined with valley inversions, worst Nov–Feb (Nazarbayev University study; EGU26-10277). It is flagged under hazards. Reviewers should check that the CAMS-derived pm25 shows a clear winter peak; if the model flattens it, consider a manual hold.

selection: Central Asia's main nomad base (the catalog has no Central Asian city yet). Mountain city with strong late-spring and early-autumn months, 30-day visa-free entry for US/UK/EU/AU, and a real winter-smog caveat.
researchNotes: Timezone: Kazakhstan moved to a single UTC+5 zone on 1 March 2024 and has no DST (Meduza, https://meduza.io/amp/en/news/2024/01/19/kazakhstan-to-switch-to-single-time-zone-on-march-1). Advisory: travel.state.gov served a Cloudflare challenge, which was not bypassed. Level and date were read from the State Department's cadataapi feed: 'Kazakhstan - Level 1: Exercise Normal Precautions', Published 2026-08-17T20:00-04:00, recorded as 2026-08-18 to match the existing Istanbul convention. The only hazard the advisory names is flooding. Visa: the newest official gov.kz text found is the New York consulate page (resumed 7 January 2022). The FCDO confirms the 30-day / 90-in-180 rule is current; the US and AU rules weren't checked on a 2026 page of their own governments. Earthquake risk is real (FCDO) but isn't seasonal, so it isn't flagged. 2026-10-03 review: Medeu rink closed for a two-year reconstruction from late March 2025 (https://www.kt.kz/eng/society/almaty_s_medeu_skating_rink_to_close_for_two-year-long_1377975682.html; completion scheduled Q4 2027 per zakon.kz).
